technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract, each bidder in his/their name should have Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor to an extent of Rs.10.59 lakh in at least one similar nature of work in any one of the last 5 years, i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 in any of the Government / Public undertaking. Order copies/ certificates issued from the cadre not less than the rank of Executive Engineer should be scanned and uploaded
The bidder should have valid PWD registration.

To qualify for award of this contract, each bidder in his/their name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.21.18 lakh, in at least two financial years in the last 5 years, i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26. Audited financial statement for the said five years duly signed by the Charted Accountant (with UDIN) should be uploaded.
